title: Bob Lyons, the Olympia band and Almer Talbert
summary: He played short stints with Bob Lyons and Arnold DePass's Olympia band, and recalls Talbert and Rudolph Boyle.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Are there any of the other bands that you had notes about that you wanted to mention?
Well, I also played a short time with Bob Lyons.
Oh yeah, uptown then.
Yeah, played several jobs with him. And I played with the Olympia band which was Arnold Dupas. Drummer.
Who else was with the Olympia? Do you remember the trumpet player?
The trumpet player was Almer Talbot. Oh yeah.
How did he play in the old days? I heard him late years with George Lewis a couple of times. How did he play and was he real good early or how did he sound when...
He was about the same I think. About the same of it.
Yeah. Was he considered one of the better trumpet players? I never did know if he was considered one of the very best or just an ordinary one or what?
Just, well, I think he was just, he was considered just one of the ordinary ones. But, but he was, he was such a good showman with his singing, you know.
Well, I started to ask about Emmanuel Perez. I no doubt you heard him. He stayed down here all his life.
Yeah, well I, I played a couple of jobs with Emmanuel Perez. I did Millen Boy. A couple of times I played out there with him.
I was going to ask about the, when you played with Bob Lyons. Can you remember anybody who was in the band then, at that time?
The only one I can remember was Rudolph, Rudolph Boyle.
Yeah, what did he play?
The drummer.
Oh, the drummer.
Big, big guy. Ever said that fella? Tall, ever said.
Yeah. Where did you play with Bob Lyons? Is it dances or private parties or homes or what?
We played several parties. I don't think I played about four or five times with that group.
